summary.text: Tracy Miller is a Republican member of the Utah House of Representatives for District 45, in office since 2025, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026, general election.
She previously served on the Jordan Board of Education from 2017 to 2024.

paragraphs.text: Tracy Miller was born in California and earned a bachelor's degree from Utah State University in 1992 and a graduate degree from Brigham Young University in 1994.

In a 2026 Ballotpedia survey, she said she has a bachelor's degree in human resource management with a minor in economics and a master's degree in organizational behavior, has a long record of volunteer service, and has been married to her husband, Mike, for 30 years.
She served on the Jordan School District board from 2017 to 2024, including four years as president, according to Ballotpedia and her survey.
Miller took office in the Utah House in January 2025, succeeding Susan Pulsipher.
In the survey she listed affordability, strong families and leading with integrity as her key campaign messages, and named education and the Great Salt Lake among her policy interests.
